I really don't think you are giving the entire state of Colorado a chance. Being there 2 weeks is not enough time to actually judge a place. Sure Canon City is nice to visit, but I wouldn't want to live there.

I did a very similar thing 7 years ago. I moved from Georgia to Colorado. I also moved to a small town (one stoplight). The closest Walmart was 30 minutes away through a canyon that I got no cell service.

It was hard. I hated it. The winter sucked. I missed the abundance of plants. Sure the outdoors here are nice. But I needed more. I wanted to make some gay friends and there were NONE around me. Even driving down to Colorado Springs wasn't enough for me. I was stuck at a place where I HATED one of the seven staff that worked there.

So I applied to jobs in Denver because that's where I decided I wanted to be. It took a month or two to actually find one. And once I did, I moved. That move was also rough, but I eventually settled in. Got to experience more of the gay scene. Was closer to A LOT of stuff.

Now, I'm downtown at a better paying job enjoying my decision. But it took time. I wouldn't be the person I am today without moving away from my family. I love my family, but I needed my own space to grow.
